# Lowell Affordable Housing Trust

*Meeting Agenda*

Date: November 18, 2026

Time: 4:30 PM

Location: Lowell City Hall (375 Merrimack Street) – 2nd Floor (*Mayor's Reception Room*) and via Zoom, remote participation

## AGENDA:

I. Welcome & Accept Communication/ Remote Participation (Zoom) Communication Remote / Zoom Participation: *Meetings Will Be Held via Zoom Using Remote Participation As Follows: Members Of The Public May View The Meeting Via LTC.Org (On-Line; Live Streaming; Or Local Cable Channel 6). Those Wishing To Speak Regarding A Specific Agenda Item Shall Register To Speak In Advance Of The Meeting By Sending Email To DPD With A Phone Number To Call So That You May Be Issued Zoom Link To The Meeting. Email Address Is gcoulouras@lowellma.gov. If No Access to Email You May Contact DPD At 978-674-1412. All Request Must Be Done Before 12:00 PM On The Day Of Meeting. For Zoom assistance - HTTPS://SUPPORT.ZOOM.US/HC/EN-US/ARTICLES/201362193-JOINING-A-MEETING*

II. Roll Call

III. Call Meeting to Order

IV. Approve Minutes of October 21, 2026 AHTF Board Meeting

V. New Business – Presentation and loan funding request from Tha Chhan on behalf of Revitalization Effort Toward New Urbanism, Inc. ("RENU") and The Lowell Housing Authority (LHA) for The Merrimack Corridor Development Project. RENU is requesting $300,000.00 of CPC sourced funding from the AHTF to assist in the creation of 118 affordable rental homes. RENU is also requesting an additional $395,000.00 of ARPA sourced funding from The AHTF to assist in the creation of the same 118 affordable rental homes which are up to 80% AMI across two buildings in Lowell's Acre neighborhood.

VI. Discussion

VII. New Business – Update of the 500,00.00 Bridge Club / Troubled Waters AHTF loan payments

VIII. Discussion

IX. New Business – Update of new vetted funding opportunities from The City of Lowell Executive Staff

X. Discussion

XI. Schedule for next meeting November 23, 2026 @ 4:30 in the MRR 2cnd Floor City Hall

XII. Adjournment
